pair.searchQuery: Heads of Innovation or CTOs at European hotel groups (50+ properties) actively researching or piloting sustainability tech, especially energy/resource management. Looking for direct contacts, not just leads.

userContactFile.positioning:
As a Partner at Nova Hospitality Ventures, I focus on identifying and investing in early-stage technology companies disrupting the European hospitality landscape. My background isn’t simply *about* hotels; it’s *from* hotels. For fifteen years, I lived and breathed hotel operations, starting as a front desk agent and culminating in a Regional General Manager role overseeing a portfolio of properties for the Stellar Hotels group. This hands-on experience provides me with a unique perspective when evaluating the potential of new technologies – I understand not just *if* a solution is innovative, but *how* it will actually function within the complex realities of hotel management. 

Currently, I’m deeply involved in shaping Nova’s investment thesis around sustainable hospitality solutions, recognizing the increasing pressure on the industry to reduce its environmental impact. We're actively looking at companies leveraging AI and data analytics to optimize resource consumption, personalize guest experiences around eco-conscious choices, and streamline operational efficiencies. I also dedicate significant time to mentoring our portfolio companies, offering guidance on go-to-market strategies, navigating the intricacies of hotel partnerships, and building strong relationships with key decision-makers. 

Beyond investment, I’m a passionate advocate for fostering collaboration between startups and established hotel operators. I believe the future of hospitality lies in bridging this gap, and I’m committed to facilitating meaningful connections that drive innovation and deliver tangible value to both sides. I regularly speak at industry events and participate in advisory boards to champion this vision. Ultimately, I’m building a portfolio that not only generates strong returns but also contributes to a more sustainable and guest-centric hospitality industry.
userContactFile.lookingFor:
I'm actively seeking connections within the following areas:

**Startups (Seed – Series A):**
• Hospitality tech companies based in Europe (particularly Benelux, DACH, and Scandinavia).
• Focus areas: Guest experience, revenue management, operational efficiency, sustainability, and innovative F&B solutions.
• Must have a demonstrable MVP, early traction (paying customers preferred), and a strong, adaptable founding team.
• *Not* interested in companies focused solely on loyalty programs or outdated PMS systems.

**Hotel Operators:**
• Heads of Innovation, CTOs, and General Managers at hotel groups with 50+ properties.
• Individuals open to piloting new technologies and providing feedback on potential solutions.
• Seeking introductions to operators actively exploring sustainability initiatives.

**Investors:**
• Angel investors and VC firms co-investing in the hospitality tech space.
• Interested in exploring syndication opportunities and sharing insights on market trends.

**Mentors/Advisors:**
• Experienced hospitality entrepreneurs who have successfully scaled tech companies.
• Individuals with deep knowledge of the European investment landscape.

**I am *not* looking for:**
• Sales pitches for unproven technologies.
• Individuals lacking a clear understanding of the hospitality industry.
• Connections solely interested in fundraising without a strong business plan.
userContactFile.introPreferences:
• Introductions should be to individuals who can genuinely contribute to my investment thesis or provide valuable operational insights.
• Ideal connections have a demonstrated track record of innovation and a willingness to challenge the status quo.
• Please provide a brief summary of the individual’s background and their relevance to my areas of interest *before* making the introduction.
• *Do not* introduce me to individuals solely looking for funding – I prefer to proactively source deals.
• Avoid introductions to individuals who are overly promotional or lack a clear understanding of the hospitality industry.
• I prefer introductions via email with a concise, well-written message.
userContactFile.personalPreferences: I prefer to receive information via email and respond promptly to direct messages on LinkedIn. I appreciate concise and well-structured communication, avoiding unnecessary jargon or fluff.
userContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences:
• I prefer meetings to be focused and efficient, with a clear agenda.
• Please send any relevant materials (pitch decks, demos) in advance.
• I am generally available for 30-minute video calls. 
• Please include a calendar invite with suggested times.
userContactFile.background:
• **Nova Hospitality Ventures, Amsterdam** (2021 – Present) – Partner. Lead investor for seed and Series A rounds, focusing on hospitality technology startups in Europe. Responsible for deal sourcing, due diligence, investment structuring, and portfolio management. Key achievements include leading Nova’s investment in ‘GuestFlow’ (a guest messaging and personalization platform) which saw a 3x return within 18 months.
• **Stellar Hotels, London & Various Locations** (2006 – 2021) – Progressively held roles including Front Desk Agent, Assistant Manager, Hotel Manager, and Regional General Manager. • **Skills:** Venture Capital, Investment Analysis, Deal Sourcing, Due Diligence, Hospitality Management, P&L Management, Revenue Management, Operational Efficiency, Team Leadership, Negotiation, Public Speaking, Fluent in English, Spanish, and conversational Dutch.
userContactFile.locationAvailability: I am currently based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. I travel frequently throughout Europe for work, primarily to Germany, the UK, and Scandinavia. While I am happy to conduct meetings remotely, I am open to considering relocation for the right opportunity. I prioritize companies with a strong European presence.
userContactFile.notes: Diego is highly direct and values efficiency. He responds best to concise communication and a clear articulation of value. He appreciates data-driven pitches and isn't easily swayed by hype. He’s a strong advocate for sustainability and will be particularly receptive to solutions addressing this area. He’s a valuable source of operational insights and can provide candid feedback on potential solutions. Recent conversations indicate he's actively seeking a company specializing in AI-powered energy management for hotels. He’s been attending the Hospitality Tomorrow conference regularly – good conversation starter. Avoid lengthy presentations; he prefers a quick demo followed by a focused discussion. He’s generally responsive on LinkedIn but prefers email for detailed follow-ups.

matchContactFile.positioning:
I’m Alejandro Abara, a globally-minded growth strategist specializing in market entry and expansion for technology companies. My career path is somewhat unconventional – I began as a professional translator and cultural consultant, spending years immersed in nuanced communication and cross-cultural understanding. This foundation has proven invaluable in my subsequent role as a business development leader, allowing me to forge strong relationships with international partners and navigate complex negotiations with sensitivity and precision. 

I thrive in environments demanding adaptability and creative problem-solving. I don’t just *sell* a product or service; I build bridges between cultures, understand local market dynamics, and craft tailored strategies for sustainable growth. I’ve consistently demonstrated success in identifying and capitalizing on untapped opportunities in emerging markets, particularly in Latin America and Southeast Asia. 

Currently, I operate as a fractional Chief Growth Officer, partnering with a select portfolio of early-stage tech companies. I'm passionate about supporting innovative ventures with the potential for significant impact, and I bring a hands-on approach to driving revenue, building brand awareness, and establishing strong international presence. I’m looking for a new challenge – a company with ambitious global goals and a willingness to embrace a data-driven, culturally-intelligent growth strategy. My expertise lies in building and leading high-performing teams, developing go-to-market strategies, and securing strategic partnerships that accelerate revenue growth. I am particularly interested in companies operating in the sustainable energy, fintech, or agtech sectors.
matchContactFile.lookingFor:
I am actively seeking connections that fall into the following categories:

**Priority 1: Portfolio Company Addition**
* **Target Profile:** Early-stage (Seed to Series B) tech companies with a proven product-market fit and ambitious global expansion plans, *specifically* targeting Latin America or Southeast Asia.
* **Ideal Sectors:** Sustainable Energy (Renewables, Energy Storage, Smart Grids), Fintech (Digital Payments, Blockchain, Financial Inclusion), Agtech (Precision Farming, Supply Chain Optimization).
* **Stage:** Companies actively raising Series A or B funding, or recently closed.
* **Geography:** Headquarters in North America or Europe, with a strong interest in expansion outside of those regions.

**Priority 2: Investor Connections**
* **Target Profile:** Venture Capitalists, Angel Investors, and Family Offices specializing in emerging market investments.
* **Focus Areas:** Fintech, Cleantech, and Agtech in Latin America and Southeast Asia.
* **Investment Stage:** Seed to Series B.

**Not a Good Fit:**
* Companies solely focused on the North American market.
* Opportunities requiring significant upfront capital investment from my side.
* Individuals offering generic business consulting services without a specific focus on international expansion.
matchContactFile.introPreferences:
- **Hard Requirements:**
  * The person you're introducing me to *must* be directly involved in decision-making related to international expansion or investment.
  * They should have a demonstrable track record of success in emerging markets.
  * Please include a brief, personalized note explaining *why* you think we would be a good fit.

- **Soft Preferences:**
  * Introductions to founders or senior leaders are preferred.
  * I appreciate introductions that highlight shared interests or common connections.
  * Avoid introducing me to individuals who are primarily focused on sales or marketing – I'm looking for strategic partners.

- **Introduction Style:**
  * Keep it concise and focused on the value I can bring to the table.
  * Briefly mention my background as a fractional CGO and my expertise in Latin America and Southeast Asia.
  * Do *not* send a lengthy, generic introduction email.  I respond best to brief, targeted messages.
matchContactFile.personalPreferences: I prefer to communicate via email or LinkedIn Messaging. I check both regularly. I am generally responsive, but please allow up to 24 hours for a reply, especially when traveling. For scheduling, Calendly is the most efficient method.
matchContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: I generally block out Mondays for focused work. I am available for meetings Tuesday - Friday. I prefer video calls over phone calls whenever possible.

I anticipate being in São Paulo, Brazil, for two weeks in November and in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, in December. I am readily available for virtual meetings regardless of location.
matchContactFile.notes:

* I previously connected with David Chen (VC at Apex Capital) last month. He seemed interested in the Southeast Asia market but is currently fully allocated. Worth checking back with him in Q1 next year.
* I'm currently deep in due diligence with a potential fintech client in Colombia. Initial findings are promising, but further investigation is needed regarding regulatory compliance.
*  Please *avoid* overly formal introductions. A concise email with a clear value proposition is preferred. I appreciate directness and efficiency.  I'm particularly interested in warm introductions from mutual connections who can vouch for my experience in international market entry.

qc.judge_reasoning: Person A is looking for specific contacts at European hotel groups to pilot sustainability tech, while Person B is a fractional CGO focused on market entry into Latin America and Southeast Asia for fintech, agtech, and general sustainable energy. There is no overlap in their target markets, industry focus, or professional needs; Person A is an investor in European hospitality tech, and Person B is a growth strategist for emerging markets. Introducing them would not provide value to either party as their goals are fundamentally misaligned.
